hint.text:
Parentheses are used to add extra information that helps to explain or clarify something in a sentence. The sentence must make sense if the extra information is removed.

Brackets can be used when the extra information should stand out. They can come with their own extra punctuation, like an exclamation mark.

instruction.text: Drag the brackets to the correct place in the sentence.
